nat_rewrite: | ∀ a b c : Nat, (a + b) + c = (a + c) + b
nat_induction: | ∀ a b : Nat, Nat.succ a + b = Nat.succ (a + b)
list_induction: (h0 h1 : Type) (h2 : h0 → h1) | ∀ xs ys : List h0, List.map h2 (xs ++ ys) = List.map h2 xs ++ List.map h2 ys
list_exists: | ∀ (α : Type) (x : α) (xs : List α), ∃ ys : List α, List.length ys = Nat.succ (List.length xs) ∧ List.tail ys = xs
tree_induction: induct_tree h1 as h2 h3 h4 h5 h6
(h0 : Type) (h1 : PilotTree h0) | PilotTree.nodes (PilotTree.mirror h1) = PilotTree.nodes h1
